note: Every scene, layout and style Clayform shipped when clayform/1 was frozen (release 0.9.0). Later versions must load all of them. Do not edit: a new format gets a corpus file of its own.

biped.name: Biped character
biped.notes: Stylized character ~1.1 m. Roles drive walk/idle/wave. Recolor via palette; swap head/hair shapes for species.

quadruped.name: Quadruped
quadruped.notes: Dog-like quadruped ~0.8 m long. Change ears, snout and tail for cat, fox, cow, dino.

bird.name: Bird
bird.notes: Round stylized bird ~0.35 m. fly and hop clips work out of the box.

fish.name: Fish
fish.notes: Stylized fish ~0.5 m, faces +Z. swim clip sways the tail.

slime.name: Slime
slime.notes: Blob creature ~0.5 m sculpted with inflate/dent — a sculpting example.

robot.name: Robot
robot.notes: Boxy robot ~1.2 m with glowing eyes and antenna.

car.name: Toy car
car.notes: Chunky toy car ~1.2 m. Wheels are separate so they spin in the drive clip.

spaceship.name: Spaceship
spaceship.notes: Arcade fighter ~1.6 m long, faces +Z. Glowing engines.

house.name: Cottage
house.notes: Small cottage ~2.4 m tall. Door and windows are carved; chimney on the roof.

tree.name: Tree
tree.notes: Stylized tree ~2.6 m: tapered trunk + three canopy blobs with surface noise.

rock.name: Rock
rock.notes: Boulder with a smaller stone, noise displacement, moss and a flattened base.

crystal.name: Crystal cluster
crystal.notes: Glowing crystal cluster ~0.7 m on a rock base.

sword.name: Sword
sword.notes: Hero sword ~1 m, lying along Y. Blade metal, gold guard, leather grip.

chest.name: Treasure chest
chest.notes: Wooden chest ~0.9 m: half-round lid, metal bands, gold lock. Carve order matters — lid_cut only trims the lid parts listed before it.

barrel.name: Barrel
barrel.notes: Wooden barrel ~0.8 m: an ellipsoid trimmed flat by intersect, vertical staves, iron hoops.

torch.name: Torch
torch.notes: Wall-less standing torch ~0.7 m with a fire effect on top.

knight.name: Knight
knight.notes: Small armored knight ~1.1 m holding a sword. Metal via palette; the sword is separate.

wizard.name: Wizard
wizard.notes: Robed wizard ~1.3 m with a long beard and a tall hat. Recolor the robe via palette.

cat.name: Cat
cat.notes: Sitting-height cat on four legs ~0.6 m long with pointed ears and a thin tail.

frog.name: Frog
frog.notes: Squat cartoon frog ~0.35 m with big eyes on top and folded legs; hop clip included.

penguin.name: Penguin
penguin.notes: Round penguin ~0.5 m with flippers, a beak and orange feet.

teddy.name: Teddy bear
teddy.notes: Plush teddy bear ~0.45 m sitting upright, with round ears and a stitched snout.

ghost.name: Ghost
ghost.notes: Floating cartoon ghost ~0.6 m with a wavy hem, glowing faintly; hover clip.

dragon.name: Baby dragon
dragon.notes: Chubby baby dragon ~0.7 m long with bat wings, horns, a spiked tail and a belly.

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.notes: Plump chicken ~0.4 m with a comb, wattle, tail feathers and thin legs.

truck.name: Pickup truck
truck.notes: Toy pickup truck ~1.4 m with an open bed, headlights and spinning wheels.

plane.name: Propeller plane
plane.notes: Chunky propeller plane ~1.5 m long, modeled in flight; the propeller spins in the spin clip.

boat.name: Sailboat
boat.notes: Small sailboat ~1.4 m long: hull, deck, mast and a triangle sail.

rocket.name: Cartoon rocket
rocket.notes: Retro rocket ~1.3 m with fins, a porthole and an engine glow; smoke trail effect.

tower.name: Castle tower
tower.notes: Round stone tower ~3.8 m with battlements, arrow slits, a door and a flag.

well.name: Well
well.notes: Stone well ~1.6 m with a wooden roof frame and a bucket.

lamppost.name: Lamp post
lamppost.notes: Victorian street lamp ~2.4 m with a glowing lantern head.

tent.name: Tent
tent.notes: Camping tent ~1.3 m: a triangular canvas with an open flap and guy ropes.

pine.name: Pine tree
pine.notes: Stylized pine ~1.8 m with three stacked faceted tiers.

cactus.name: Potted cactus
cactus.notes: Saguaro-style cactus with two arms in a terracotta pot, ~0.7 m.

campfire.name: Campfire
campfire.notes: Crossed logs in a ring of stones with fire and a little smoke, ~0.8 m across.

table.name: Wooden table
table.notes: Tavern table ~1.2 m long on four legs.

chair.name: Wooden chair
chair.notes: Simple chair ~0.9 m with a slatted back.

shield.name: Round shield
shield.notes: Viking-style round shield ~0.7 m with a metal rim and a boss.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.notes: Hand lantern ~0.4 m with a glowing glass core, metal frame and ring handle.

goblin.name: Goblin
goblin.notes: Stylized character ~1.1 m. Roles drive walk/idle/wave. Recolor via palette; swap head/hair shapes for species.
